exposure: enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocol for cesarean deliveries (CD)
outcome: Time to first passage of flatus
cohort: 448 women who underwent either planned or unplanned CD in six different centers between September 2020 and March 2021
finding: The ERAS protocol, including early serving of ice cream and coffee in the early postoperative period, enabled early discharge and a faster return of bowel function.
